desc.p: This method allows users to create a new geocache.
This method is only available on installations that support cache editing. Check the has_cache_editing field in services/apisrv/installation before calling it.

req.name: cache_name
req.p: Name of the cache. Must not be empty or exceed 256 characters.

req.name: cache_type
req.p: Type of the cache. Must be one of: Traditional, Multi, Quiz, Moving, Virtual, Webcam, Other, Event, Own, Podcast.

req.name: latitude
req.p: Latitude of the cache location. Must be between -90 and 90.

req.name: longitude
req.p: Longitude of the cache location. Must be between -180 and 180.

opt.name: difficulty
opt.p: Difficulty rating of the cache. Must be between 1.0 and 5.0.

opt.name: terrain
opt.p: Terrain rating of the cache. Must be between 1.0 and 5.0.

opt.name: size2
opt.p: Size of the cache container. One of: none, nano, micro, small, regular, large, xlarge, other.

opt.name: short_description
opt.p: One-line tagline for the cache. Must not exceed 255 characters.

opt.name: description
opt.p: Full HTML description of the cache.

opt.name: hint2
opt.p: Plain-text hint or spoiler for the cache.

opt.name: date_hidden
opt.p: ISO 8601 date when the cache was/will be hidden. Defaults to today's date.

opt.name: req_passwd
opt.p: Boolean. If true, a password is required to submit "Found it" log entries.

opt.name: alt_wpts
opt.p: JSON array of additional waypoints. Each waypoint object should have: name, location (lat|lon format), type, description. Waypoint types: parking, trailhead, path, stage, physical-stage, virtual-stage, final, poi, other.

returns.p: A dictionary of the following structure:

li.p: success - true, if the cache was created successfully.
message - status message for the user.
cache_code - the unique code assigned to the newly created cache.
cache_id - the internal ID of the newly created cache.
alt_wpts_count - number of additional waypoints created.
url - direct URL to the cache on the OC website.
